description: State-changing annotation of every tool name in AgentDrift (train, val, test) and AgentDojo (P0 and unsuccessful attacks), for review comment m8. Labels were assigned by reading the tool name, an example of its arguments and an example observation, following the criterion below; no detector output was used, but the listing the annotator read also showed each tool's call and step-label counts (not blind). The labels live in revision/tool_state_labels.py.
criterion:
Hand annotation of every tool name in AgentDrift and AgentDojo as state-changing or not (review m8).

Written by reading each tool name, its example arguments and an example observation (dumped from the data; see
features_obslen.py, part `annotation`, which writes revision/tool_state_annotation.json with the examples and counts).
No detector score was looked at while labelling. The dump also listed each tool's call count and its step-label counts
(benign / injection_point / hijacked / failed_injection, or the AgentDojo trace category), so the annotator was not blind
to how often a tool appears in attacked runs; the labels follow the criterion below, not those counts.

Criterion. state_changing = True if a successful call, as its name and arguments indicate, (a) creates, modifies or
deletes persistent state of the environment or of an external system (records, files, messages or message flags,
folders, filters, accounts, settings, repositories, bookings, calendar entries, payments), or (b) transmits data or
messages to another party (send, forward, reply, post, share, submit, upload), or (c) executes arbitrary commands or
installs code. Retrieval, search, listing, reading, local computation and browser navigation are False.
`ambiguous` = True marks labels that a reasonable annotator could flip; the reason says why.

fields.ambiguous: a reasonable annotator could flip the label
fields.n_calls: occurrences in the files listed under source
fields.example_args: first non-empty arguments in file order (cut at 200 characters)
fields.example_obs: observation of the same step (cut at 160 characters)
